description: NaSr(PO₃)₃ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.80 Å. Sr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Sr-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.81 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.62 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.63 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.63 Å. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sr and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Sr, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Sr, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one P atom.
